title: BRAVO XY Accelerator and COUNT 5 measurement verification

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The BRAVO accelerator is available only with Y Speed ON, REC stopped, and a valid empty selected BAR; its asynchronous result rechecks editor lifetime and selected BAR.
Loading changes only the selected empty BAR, publishes once, preserves COUNT/DEPTH and all other state, prevents overwrite, and round-trips through the existing state representation.
The authored motion has normalized X return intervals 0.20, 0.13 and 0.09 BAR and the existing Y Speed path produces a measurable later acceleration/pitch-direction difference without a DSP change.
COUNT measurement covers OFF, CUSTOM and all eight factory presets with XY absent, stereo phase-coded input, intra-BAR length expiry and one-BAR boundary, next BAR OFF and active, and DEPTH 0/100.

COUNT evidence compensates the fixed 1024 samples and records residual classification as old processed PCM, temporary dry attenuation, or no difference, with duration; no COUNT production DSP changes are made.
Focused native tests, Windows CI and artifact provenance pass on one source SHA; Jev and Codex final reviews leave no FAIL or UNKNOWN before manual-test placement.
